POWER MECHANICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: POWER MECHANICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Work alone with eyes closed

2. When learning Suspension system, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Suspension system.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Suspension system.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Suspension system.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Suspension system.

3. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Keyboard
   C. Speaker
   D. Monitor

4. When learning Isometric projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Isometric projection.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Isometric projection.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Isometric projection.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Isometric projection.

5. When learning Orthographic projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Orthographic projection.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Orthographic projection.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Orthographic projection.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Orthographic projection.

6. When learning Braking system, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Braking system.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Braking system.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Braking system.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Braking system.

7. When learning Principles of Power Mechanics, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Principles of Power Mechanics.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Principles of Power Mechanics.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Principles of Power Mechanics.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Principles of Power Mechanics.

8. When learning ISO Thread forms, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after ISO Thread forms.
   B. Skip safety briefings for ISO Thread forms.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for ISO Thread forms.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for ISO Thread forms.

9. When learning Steering system, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Steering system.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Steering system.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Steering system.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Steering system.

10. When learning Metalwork processes in power mechanics, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Metalwork processes in power mechanics.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Metalwork processes in power mechanics.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Metalwork processes in power mechanics.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Metalwork processes in power mechanics.

11. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Information and Communication Technology

12. When learning Properties and application of Materials in Power mechanics, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Properties and application of Materials in Power mechanics.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Properties and application of Materials in Power mechanics.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Properties and application of Materials in Power mechanics.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Properties and application of Materials in Power mechanics.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Four- Stroke Petrol Engine and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Two-stroke petrol engine and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Two- Stroke Petrol Engine and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Petrol fuel Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
